map.按玻璃厚度与种类计算退火曲线：保温温度、保温时间、临界区间慢冷速率与快冷速率，估: Computes the annealing curve from glass thickness and type: soak temperature, soak time, critical-range slow cooling rate and fast cooling rate, and estimates the total annealing time.
Core formula (by input variables): max(15,Math.round(4×t)); g.AP+5
map.📖 查看「玻璃退火曲线计算使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to glass annealing curve calculation
map.玻璃应力在数分钟内消除的温度，约 10¹²~10¹³ Pa·s 粘度。: The temperature at which glass stress is relieved within a few minutes, at a viscosity of about 10¹² to 10¹³ Pa·s.
map.低于此温度应力不再消除，是慢冷下限。: Below this temperature stress is no longer relieved; it is the lower limit for slow cooling.
map.① 升温至退火点并保温（消除应力）；② 在 AP→SP 临界区间慢冷（防止再生应: ① heat to the annealing point and soak (relieve stress); ② cool slowly through the critical AP→SP range (prevent stress from forming again); ③ below SP, cooling can be faster.
map.与厚度平方成反比，rate = K / t²（°C/min），K 因玻璃而异。厚: Inversely proportional to the square of the thickness, rate = K / t² (°C/min), where K varies by glass. Thick glass must be cooled extremely slowly.
map.参考点：钠钙玻璃 AP≈545°C/SP≈515°C；硼硅 AP≈560°C/S: Reference points: soda-lime glass AP ≈ 545°C / SP ≈ 515°C; borosilicate AP ≈ 560°C / SP ≈ 510°C; lead glass AP ≈ 445°C / SP ≈ 415°C; potash-soda AP ≈ 525°C / SP ≈ 495°C.
map.退火工艺：按玻璃种类与厚度定保温温度、保温时间与临界区间慢冷速率: Annealing process: set the soak temperature, soak time and critical-range slow cooling rate by glass type and thickness
map.应力控制：由退火点(AP)到应变点(SP)慢冷消除残余应力，避免自裂: Stress control: slow cooling from the annealing point (AP) to the strain point (SP) removes residual stress and prevents spontaneous cracking
map.排产估算：按快冷速率估总退火时间，辅助炉次与节拍安排: Scheduling: estimate the total annealing time from the fast cooling rate to plan furnace loads and cycle time
map.算法：保温温度=退火点 AP+5°C，保温时间=max(15, round(4×: Algorithm: soak temperature = annealing point AP + 5°C, soak time = max(15, round(4 × t)) minutes (t is thickness in mm); critical slow cooling rate Ks / t² °C/min (× 60 for °C/h), slow cooling duration = (AP − SP) / slow rate; fast cooling rate Kf / t² °C/min (capped at 60), fast cooling duration = (SP − final cooling temperature) / fast rate; total annealing time = soak + slow cooling + fast cooling. Requires thickness > 0 and a valid final cooling temperature.
map.例1（钠钙玻璃 t=6mm，冷却至 50°C）：AP=545、SP=515、Ks: Example 1 (soda-lime glass t = 6 mm, cooling to 50°C): AP = 545, SP = 515, Ks = 4.2, Kf = 18 → soak 550°C / 24 min; slow cooling 4.2 / 36 = 0.1167°C/min = 7.0°C/h, slow duration (545 − 515) / 0.1167 = 257 min; fast cooling 18 / 36 = 0.50°C/min, fast (515 − 50) / 0.5 = 930 min; total 24 + 257 + 930 = 1211 min = 20 h 11 min. Example 2 (borosilicate glass t = 10 mm, cooling to 30°C): AP = 560, Ks = 3.5, Kf = 20 → soak 565°C / 40 min; slow cooling 3.5 / 100 = 0.035°C/min = 2.1°C/h, slow 50 / 0.035 = 1429 min; fast cooling 20 / 100 = 0.20°C/min, fast 480 / 0.2 = 2400 min; total 3869 min = 64 h 29 min.
map.为什么临界区间要慢冷？: Why cool slowly through the critical range?
map.AP→SP 是玻璃从粘弹态转为刚性、应力可松弛的区间；慢冷让内部应力随温度梯度释: AP → SP is the range where glass changes from a viscoelastic state to a rigid one and stress can still relax; slow cooling lets internal stress release along the temperature gradient, while fast cooling freezes in thermal stress that later causes spontaneous cracking. The slow cooling rate is inversely proportional to the square of the thickness — the thicker, the slower.
map.不同玻璃参数差在哪？: How do parameters differ between glass types?
map.钠钙/硼硅/铅/钾钠的退火点 AP、应变点 SP 与系数 Ks/Kf 不同（如钠: Soda-lime, borosilicate, lead and potash-soda glasses differ in annealing point AP, strain point SP and the Ks / Kf coefficients (for example soda-lime AP = 545°C, borosilicate AP = 560°C, lead glass AP = 445°C), which set the soak temperature and slow cooling rate; at the same thickness, borosilicate cools more slowly and takes longer overall because Ks is smaller.

map.临界区间慢冷速率 = Ks ÷ 厚度²（℃/min）: Slow-cooling rate in the critical range = Ks ÷ thickness² (°C/min)
map.慢冷区间 = AP → SP（应变点）；慢冷时长 = (AP − SP) ÷ 慢: Slow-cooling range = AP → SP (strain point); slow-cooling duration = (AP − SP) ÷ slow-cooling rate
map.快冷速率 = Kf ÷ 厚度²（℃/min），上限 60: Fast-cooling rate = Kf ÷ thickness² (°C/min), capped at 60
map.快冷区间 = SP → 目标温度；快冷时长 = 区间 ÷ 快冷速率: Fast-cooling range = SP → target temperature; fast-cooling duration = range ÷ fast-cooling rate
map.总退火时间 = 保温 + 慢冷 + 快冷: Total annealing time = holding + slow cooling + fast cooling
map.三阶段卡片：升温保温 → 临界慢冷 → 快速冷却: Three-stage cards: heat and hold → critical slow cooling → fast cooling
map.分步输出各阶段温度、速率与时长: Step output of temperature, rate and duration for each stage
map.Ks/Kf 与 AP/SP 按玻璃品类（钠钙/高硼硅等）查表: Ks/Kf and AP/SP are looked up by glass type (soda-lime / borosilicate, etc.)
map.约束：厚度 > 0 且目标温度有效: Constraint: thickness > 0 and a valid target temperature
map.玻璃退火曲线估算（表列 AP/SP/Ks/Kf 为演示参考值）: Glass annealing curve estimate (table AP/SP/Ks/Kf are demonstration values)
map.保温时间 = max(最小保温时间, round(保温系数 × 厚度)) min: Hold time = max(minimum hold, round(hold factor × thickness)) min
map.慢冷速率 = Ks ÷ 厚度²（℃/min）；Ks 可用厂家值覆盖: Slow-cool rate = Ks ÷ thickness² (°C/min); Ks can be overridden with manufacturer data
map.保温后缓冷 = 保温温度 → AP，按同一慢冷速率；时长 = 5 ÷ 慢冷速率: Post-hold slow cool = hold temperature → AP at the same slow-cool rate; duration = 5 ÷ slow-cool rate
map.临界慢冷 = AP → SP（应变点）；时长 = (AP − SP) ÷ 慢冷速: Critical slow cool = AP → SP (strain point); duration = (AP − SP) ÷ slow-cool rate
map.快冷速率 = Kf ÷ 厚度²（℃/min），上限 60；Kf 可用厂家值覆盖: Fast-cool rate = Kf ÷ thickness² (°C/min), capped at 60; Kf can be overridden with manufacturer data
map.快冷区间 = SP → 目标温度；时长 = 区间 ÷ 快冷速率: Fast-cool range = SP → target temperature; duration = range ÷ fast-cool rate
map.保温与冷却合计 = 保温 + 保温后缓冷 + 临界慢冷 + 快冷: Hold plus cooling total = hold + post-hold slow cool + critical slow cool + fast cool
map.升温时间不在此模型内，须按炉体功率、装炉量与玻璃热容另行确定: Heating time is outside this model and must be determined from furnace power, load and glass heat capacity
map.约束：厚度 > 0、系数 > 0、最小保温 ≥ 0、目标温度在 0 与 SP 之: Constraints: thickness > 0, coefficients > 0, minimum hold ≥ 0, target temperature between 0 and SP
map.退火工艺粗算：按玻璃种类、厚度与厂家保温系数，估算保温及冷却各阶段时长: Rough annealing estimate: stage durations from glass type, thickness and manufacturer hold factor
map.应力控制：理解 AP→SP 临界区间为何要慢冷，以及保温温度降到 AP 也需缓冷: Stress control: why the AP→SP critical range needs slow cooling, and why cooling from hold temperature to AP also needs controlled cooling
map.排产估算：得到不含升温的保温+冷却合计，用于炉次节拍；升温时间另行按炉体确定: Production planning: obtain a hold-plus-cooling total excluding heating for furnace cycle timing; determine heating separately from the furnace
map.算法：保温温度=AP+5°C；保温时间=max(最小保温时间, round(保温: Algorithm: hold temperature = AP+5°C; hold time = max(minimum hold, round(hold factor×t)) min (defaults: 4 min/mm and 15 min, both editable). Slow-cool rate = Ks/t² °C/min (Ks can be overridden with manufacturer data); post-hold cooling from AP+5°C to AP takes 5/slow-cool rate; the AP→SP critical range takes (AP−SP)/slow-cool rate. Fast-cool rate = Kf/t² °C/min (capped at 60, Kf can be overridden); fast cooling takes (SP−final temperature)/fast-cool rate. Hold plus cooling total = hold + post-hold slow cool + critical slow cool + fast cool; heating time is excluded. Requires thickness >0, coefficients >0, minimum hold ≥0 and final temperature between 0 and SP.
map.例1（钠钙玻璃 t=6mm，冷却至 50°C）：AP=545、SP=515、Ks: Example 1 (soda-lime t=6 mm, cool to 50°C): AP=545, SP=515, Ks=4.2, Kf=18 → hold 550°C for 4×6=24 min; slow-cool 4.2/36=0.1167°C/min=7.0°C/h; post-hold slow cool 5/0.1167=43 min; critical slow cool 30/0.1167=257 min; fast-cool 18/36=0.50°C/min, 465/0.5=930 min; total 24+43+257+930=1254 min=20 h 54 min (excluding heating). Example 2 (borosilicate t=10 mm, cool to 30°C): AP=560, SP=510, Ks=3.5, Kf=20 → hold 565°C for 40 min; slow-cool 3.5/100=0.035°C/min=2.1°C/h; post-hold slow cool 5/0.035=143 min; critical slow cool 50/0.035=1429 min; fast-cool 20/100=0.20°C/min, 480/0.2=2400 min; total 40+143+1429+2400=4011 min=66 h 51 min (excluding heating).
map.保温结束后到退火点的降温算不算？: Is the cooling from hold temperature to the annealing point counted?
map.算。保温温度是 AP+5°C，若直接从 AP 开始计慢冷，会漏掉这 5°C 的降: Yes. The hold temperature is AP+5°C; starting the slow cool at AP would omit the 5°C drop. This tool treats hold temperature→AP as a separate “post-hold slow cool” at the same rate, then counts the AP→SP critical slow cool.
map.为什么叫“保温与冷却合计”而不是总退火时间？: Why is it called “hold plus cooling total” instead of total annealing time?
map.升温时间取决于炉体功率、装炉量与玻璃热容，本模型没有这些输入，无法可靠估算。因此: Heating time depends on furnace power, load and glass heat capacity; this model has no such inputs and cannot estimate it reliably. It therefore sums only hold, post-hold slow cool, critical slow cool and fast cool, and explicitly excludes heating.
map.表里的 AP/SP/Ks/Kf 能直接用于生产吗？: Can the table AP/SP/Ks/Kf values be used directly in production?
map.不能。表值是演示参考，实际随玻璃配方、炉型、装炉方式和热电偶位置变化。保温系数、: No. The table values are demonstration references and vary with glass composition, furnace type, loading pattern and thermocouple location. Hold factor, minimum hold, Ks and Kf can be overridden with manufacturer curves or trial-piece results, and must still be confirmed by process personnel.
map.按玻璃厚度与种类估算保温、保温后缓冷、临界慢冷与快冷时长；不含升温，可用厂家保温: Estimates hold, post-hold slow cool, critical slow cool and fast cool from glass thickness and type; heating is excluded and manufacturer hold factor, Ks and Kf can be supplied.
